name: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo company founded in 1935, called Nakase Kogyo Co., Ltd. until 1936, that makes and sells antimony products and metal powders. Antimony trioxide serves as a flame retardant in plastics and rubber, a polyester catalyst and a solid lubricant in brake pads, while antimony metal goes into semiconductors, storage batteries and alloys.
